page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a KVM-based, storage-dense virtual server instance powered by x86_64 architecture Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance features a massive local storage allocation of 94,489 GB composed of direct-attached HDD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline throughput of 20 Gbps.

The inclusion of nearly 95 TB of local hard disk drive storage within the node offers high storage density per instance. However, reliance on HDD media rather than NVMe or SSD storage trades off random I/O performance in favor of sequential capacity efficiency. The architecture lacks modern vector execution flags like AVX-512, limiting pure mathematical computation. This profile offers qualitative cost efficiency for high-capacity capacity requirements, making it suited for cold storage, distributed file systems, batch log analytics, and big data pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-dense virtual machine built on KVM hypervisor technology and powered by x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs, 128.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per core), and a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. A key feature of this configuration is its bundled 94,489 GB local HDD storage capacity, providing massive local disk volume directly attached to the host. The combination of 32 processing threads with vast local spinning disk capacity delivers strong resource density for sequential data handling. The instance is designed for big data processing, batch log analytics, data archiving, and large-scale distributed file systems where high capacity takes priority over low-latency random storage I/O.
